description: Unit tests for the ClientProofSource component in the QUIC protocol implementation, including certificate chain handling, key matching, and domain-specific certificate retrieval.

methods.name: TestCertChain
methods.description: Creates a reference-counted certificate chain with a test certificate.

methods.name: TestPrivateKey
methods.description: Generates a test private key from test certificate data.

methods.name: TestCertAndKey
methods.description: Returns a static pair of test certificate chain and private key.

methods.name: NullCertChain
methods.description: Returns an empty certificate chain reference.

methods.name: EmptyCertChain
methods.description: Returns a certificate chain with no certificates.

methods.name: BadCertChain
methods.description: Returns a certificate chain with invalid content.

methods.name: EmptyPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns an empty private key object.

methods.name: VerifyCertAndKeyMatches
methods.description: Checks if two CertAndKey objects match in private key and certificate chain.
